thread:
ling: Heads up — canary for tessera-v1-int8 on the translate pipeline is showing a BLEU drop for code-switched SRTs (Arabic lines that inline Japanese/Kanji).

maria: ugh, sample? quick numbers?

ling: pasted a minimal repro sample in the gist. Quick aggregated numbers from the canary run:
Baseline (tessera-v1-fp16): BLEU=31.8
Canary (tessera-v1-int8): BLEU=27.0
Delta: -4.8
Pattern: longer subtitle lines and those with explicit "\n" markers are much worse.

jihoon: can you reproduce locally with our eval harness? command pls

ling: yes. repro command I used:
```
./eval/run_eval.sh --model tessera-v1:int8 --suite srt_code_switch --lang ar-ja --detok preserve_newline
```
I suspect detok normalization is collapsing directional markers or trimming trailing NBSPs (U+00A0) which shifts tokenization.

devon: hmm earlier we swapped an int8 kernel permute order (for attention) — that also caused off-by-one token alignment in some tests. Could be either detok or kernel padding.

eva: @jihoon can you bisect the last 6 commits touching quant/attention? start from the canary build hash.

jihoon: on it — kicking off bisect. will run the 100-sample srt suite per commit.

eval-bot: Run queued: srt_code_switch (100 samples) — started (job id: 98123)

maria: FYI we shipped a detok change in 2.1.5 that trims trailing NBSPs as part of subtitle normalization — that might be the delta.

ling: quick mitigation: toggling detok_preserve_nbsp=true in canary config improved BLEU to 30.2 (still -1.6 vs fp16 but much better than -4.8).

devon: if the detok toggle recovers most of the regression, likely preprocessing introduced the worst part. But we still need to confirm kernel-level effects.

jihoon: bisect update: commit 0f4e5a7 changed attention kernel permute for int8 path — reverting that locally recovers BLEU to 31.5 (within noise).

eva: nice repro. please open revert PR and add targeted unit tests around mixed-dir SRT lines.

jihoon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/tessera/pull/2345 — revert + test + config flag to preserve NBSP/newline during detok. Running full regression now.

deploy-bot: Canary paused for tessera-v1-int8 (10% -> paused) by eva

maria: can we also add srt_code_switch to nightly regression to catch this earlier?

ling: yes — added ticket and TODO in PR to include the suite in nightly. Also adding a small unit test for: 
- RTL marker (U+200F) preservation
- trailing NBSP handling
- embedded CJK token boundary check

devon: also add a quick eval comparing KV cache behavior when detok collapses versus preserves newlines; cache alignment might hide/expose failures.

jihoon: running the extended regression now — will report if anything else arises.

ling: thanks all. good triage. once PR merges we can unpause canary and re-run canary with detok_preserve_nbsp=false to validate regress fixed end-to-end. :thumbsup:
